blocks: One person invested in creating unique experiences, handling the entire creative and technical process end to end. No separate designers, no developer handoffs.

process.label: Discover
process.description: Understand what makes your project unique: the space, the audience, the data, and the story worth telling.

process.label: Design
process.description: From there, sketch, prototype and test ideas to refine the artistic direction through an iterative process.

process.label: Develop
process.description: Bring the concept to life through a combination of cutting-edge creative software and hardware tools.

process.label: Deliver
process.description: Install the finished piece in its intended environment, including setup, calibration, and on-site support.
